thread:
Alex: Quick design review — putting up a tiny prototype for the Playground chat stream UI. Focus: streaming display, stop/regenerate affordance, token counter visibility, and prompt library drag/drop. Figma: https://figma.redwood/proto/stream-v1 (screenshots attached).
Maria: Nice! I like the compact token pill. Question: should the top-right control say 'Stop' or 'Pause' while streaming? semantics matter for users who expect 'pause and resume'. :thinking:
Jamal: Prefer 'Stop' — we don't support resume of partial streams today. If we used 'Pause' we'd need to implement resumption (and that changes KV cache behavior). Also accessibility: keyboard should stop the stream with `Esc`. Add an aria-label like `aria-label="Stop streaming response"`.
Olivia: Token counter nit: can we show both "tokens in this response" and cumulative session tokens on hover? Right now the pill reads '42 tokens' which is ambiguous. Maybe collapsed state shows per-response tokens and expands to show session and estimated cost in USD.
Patrick: Prompt library idea: allow drag from library into composer to auto-fill prompt and attach metadata (tags + pinned). Also a small 'insert as template' affordance in the right-rail. On mobile this becomes a modal.
design-bot: Checklist: 1) Stop vs Pause copy decision 2) Keyboard shortcuts doc 3) Token pill states (collapsed/expanded) 4) Prompt drag/drop prototype 5) Screen reader announcements for streaming chunks.
Maria: Copy proposal: change button to `Stop` and microcopy tooltip: "Stop the current generation; partial output will be kept." For regen we keep `Regenerate` (not `Retry`) to avoid confusion with network retries.
Jamal: Implementation notes for eng: keybindings: `Esc` => stop-stream, `Ctrl+Enter` => send/regenerate. Also we should fire analytics events: `playground.stream_started`, `playground.stream_stopped_manual`, `playground.regenerate_clicked`. eng-bot: logged — will add event names to tracking spreadsheet.
Olivia: a11y: add `role=status` or `aria-live=polite` on the stream container so screen readers announce incremental output but not be too noisy. Also ensure token pill has `aria-describedby` linking to the expanded details.
Patrick: Motion: suggestion to fade token pill in/out to reduce attention. Also when user stops mid-stream, show a small toast: "Stream stopped — partial response saved" with an undo-ish 'Continue' action (but Continue would re-run generation, not resume).
Alex: Prototype update pushed: https://figma.redwood/proto/stream-v1?node-id=234. Changes: Stop label, Esc binding in hover state, token pill expand on hover, prompt library supports drag handles. Asking for final thumbs before I hand off to eng.
Maria: small copy tweak: tooltip "Stop the current generation" -> "Stop the current generation (keeps partial output)". Clearer. :thumbsup:
Jamal: dev concern: need to throttle keyboard Esc so accidental presses don't kill long generations; maybe require a short-press vs long-press? that feels weird. I think single `Esc` is fine, but maybe show a confirmation toast with undo.
Olivia: Accessibility pass approved pending `aria-live` changes and clear focus states for token pill. I'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver check once the update is live.
eng-bot: FYI rollout plan: feature flag `playground.stream_controls_v2`, default off for 24hrs, ramp to 100% if no regressions.
Patrick: UX decision summary: 1) Label = "Stop" 2) Regen remains "Regenerate" 3) `Esc` stops stream, `Ctrl+Enter` regenerates 4) Token pill collapsed per-response, expands on hover for session/cost 5) Prompt library drag-insert supported 6) aria-live polite for stream 7) small toast + undo after stop.
Alex: Thanks everyone — I'll update the figma copy and add the ARIA notes to the dev handoff doc. Final call: any blockers?
Maria: No blockers from design.
Jamal: No blocker from eng, just keep telemetry events stable.
Olivia: I'll do the accessibility sign-off after NVDA/VoiceOver pass.
Patrick: :thumbsup: good to hand off.
Alex: Great — closing thread.
